spec.kitLine: ATK ▲20% of the skill user ATK, 3 sec
spec.assertion: Per-slug base-minus-patched diff on stat casterAtkPct proves the grant reaches ALL FOUR allies (RED under self-only/excludeSelf); every emitted value > 1000 proves flat caster-resolution (RED if authored as plain atkPct 20, which emits the raw percentage); the rAtkPctSwap counterfactual shows the nearest-wrong own-ATK encoding lands a different liter total.

casterAtkPct applies to liter (diff vs the effect-removed run) >= 50 and > 3× fullBurstStart count: GREEN only for a per-charge/per-shot trigger, RED for passive (1 apply) and RED for a fullBurstEnter mis-key (=== fbStarts).

Every prika-unique pierceDamagePct apply has durationShots undefined + a finite expiresFrame > 0 (RED for a round-count or continuous encoding); shortening the ATK window to 1 s strictly LOWERS liter damage and extending to 30 s does not lower it, pinning the window as real seconds rather than an always-on buff.

A projectileExplosionPct apply with value 20 exists for each of the four allies — RED if re-scoped to a generic Damage Up stat (attackDamagePct/trueDamagePct) or narrowed to self. Damage inertness is deliberately NOT asserted (no RL carrier in this comp; the bucket semantics of the stat are not blind-observable).
A pierceDamagePct apply with value 13.09 exists for each ally — proves the v1-inert stat was still carried for kit completeness rather than dropped or folded into a live damage stat.
it.skip — heal magnitudes are unmodelled (heal effects emit a recovery event with no HP amount), so the line has no observable payload in any fixture.

it.skip — pierce is damage-inert in v1 (partless boss, pierceDamagePct inert), so gainPierce-gated-on-Performance vs a whole-fight hasPierce flag is indistinguishable via events or totals, and the Performance OFF→ON split is likewise unobservable.

maxHpFlat applies targeting prika (diff vs the block-removed run) === fullBurstStart count, and === 0 for every teammate: RED for passive (1), RED for an interval/shot key (overshoot), RED for an allies target set. Pollution-proof because it is measured as a diff, so crown/helm HP grants cannot inflate it.
Removing the Max-HP effect leaves all four slugs' totals byte-identical — proves it was not smuggled in as an ATK-moving stat (prika carries no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer).

PAYLOAD ASSERTION: no attackDamagePct buffApply with value 25.01 exists anywhere in the control run. The Encore branch is gated on 'Sing Along takes effect', an ability no unit in this comp has, so the only faithful outcome is inertness (absent block, or a teamHas/slugs gate). RED if Encore was optimistically keyed to burstCast/fullBurstEnter/passive — a genuine over-credit of a team-wide 25% Damage Up.
it.skip — no primitive extends a named ally status window (fullBurstExtend is Full-Burst-only), and the trigger itself is inexpressible.
it.skip — burstCdr models a REDUCTION only; a cooldown increase (the Encore tradeoff) has no primitive.
it.skip — no assigned-part model; the scope-lock boss is partless.

Patching the heal to a single tick strictly reduces the run's total buffApply count (by >= 10) and does not raise crown's damage — proves the HoT was authored as 25 recovery ticks that keep crown's on-recovery consumer refreshed. RED under the classic nearest-wrong (a single instant heal with ticks omitted), which is the exact trap for a heal that looks inert in isolation.

chargeDamagePct 25 applies to all four allies with a finite expiresFrame and no durationShots; removing it strictly lowers prika's own (charge-weapon) damage while leaving the SMG ally liter byte-identical, and re-scoping it to attackDamagePct raises liter — a three-way proof that the line is charge-bucket scoped, all-ally, and time-bounded.

fixtures: controlComp('prika', true) only — liter(B1)/crown(B2)/prika/helm(B3), Fire boss, deterministic (no seed), 9 hoisted 180 s runs (base + 8 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals). helm is kept IN despite being a buff confound because removing it leaves the team with no Burst III at all (zero Full Bursts), which would make the S2 fullBurstEnter line and prika's own B2 cast untestable; crown is kept as the on-recovery consumer that makes the burst HoT observable. Confound control is done by DIFFING base against a targeted patch rather than by trimming the comp, so teammate buffs cannot pollute any count. TWO FIXTURE RISKS DISCLOSED: (1) prika is a Burst II sharing the tier with crown — the first test is the explicit non-vacuity gate on her actually casting Performance; if it REDs, the fixture (not the override) is the problem and the burst-slot group is vacuous. (2) I had NO tool access in this run, so the file could not be written to scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/prika.test.ts nor executed — the source is returned here unexecuted; the two shape ambiguities in the packet (override slot = Block[] vs {blocks:[]}, onEvent at top level vs under cfg) are handled defensively in-code (blocksOf + double-registered de-duped sink) precisely because I could not verify them by running.
gaps: S1b Outgoing healing ▲49.92% — heal magnitudes unmodelled (recovery events carry no HP amount); no observable payload.

S1b Gains Pierce while in Performance — pierce is damage-inert in v1 (partless boss, pierceDamagePct parsed-but-inert), so gainPierce(25 s, Performance-gated) vs whole-fight hasPierce is not discriminable by events or totals; the Performance OFF→ON non-vacuity split is unobservable for the same reason.

S2 Encore trigger 'when Sing Along takes effect' — cross-unit ability trigger with no schema representation; the whole branch is asserted INERT in this comp instead (over-credit guard on Attack Damage ▲25.01%).
S2 Encore Effect 2 'Performance duration ▲21 sec' — no primitive extends a named ally status window (fullBurstExtend is Full-Burst-only).
S2 Encore Effect 4 'Cooldown of Burst Skill ▲21 sec' — burstCdr models reduction only; a cooldown INCREASE has no primitive.
S2 Encore Effect 1 'Assigned Part: Singing' — no parts model (partless scope-lock boss).
Burst Effect 1 heal AMOUNT (3.04% of caster final Max HP) and Effect 1/2 'cannot be removed' — neither the HP magnitude nor removal-immunity is observable; only the tick COUNT is tested.

Projectile Explosion ▲20% damage-inertness on a non-RL comp is asserted only as emission, not as a totals no-op: whether projectileExplosionPct is flavor-gated inside the Damage Up bucket is not blind-derivable, so a totals assertion there could REY on engine semantics rather than on the override.
